subject: PrivDeploy Annex: staged witness / rollback playbook & MSA redline coordination
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearpath.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearpath.com
Date: 2027-08-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: PrivDeploy evidence & witness ask — MSA annex needs and timeline

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the demo last week — the ClearPath security and procurement teams reviewed the private deployment options and we need to lock down a few items before legal proceeds:

- We require a staged evidence deliverable (snapshot + operator witness) that can be scheduled during onboarding and repeated annually.
- We'd prefer an "escrow-lite" approach: limited snapshot custody & witnessing rather than full code escrow. The key asks are custody attestations, witness procedure, and a narrow runbook for rollback validation.
- Please send your proposed MSA annex language and a realistic timeline for evidence staging (we're aiming to align with our audit window: Sep 20–25).

Attached: evidence-checklist.pdf (high level, with our expectations). Can you share a redline for the MSA annex and confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a customer-controlled witness window and a one-year retention snapshot?

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement — ClearPath Health
M: +1 415-555-0123
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearpath.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-03T15:24:00Z
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy evidence & witness ask — MSA annex needs and timeline

Marta — thanks for the clear checklist. High level: we can support an escrow-lite pattern that we typically use with regulated healthcare customers, with a staged evidence window and operator witness.

I've attached a draft annex (CPH-MSA-Annex-draft-redline.docx) with our initial redlines and a proposed staged-evidence-timeline.xlsx. Key callouts here:

- Operator witness: Redwood will provide a timeboxed remote witnessing session (2–4 hours) with an engineer and run a pre-agreed checklist against an immutable snapshot. Witnesses are role-based and access is read-only; no customer access to private keys.
- Snapshot custody & retention: default retention 90 days; we can extend to 12 months by exhibit in Order Form. Transfer of snapshot for onsite review requires explicit approval and a limited signed access agreement.
- Rollback validation: Annex includes a rollback verification procedure (non-production test, acceptance criteria). Customer can request a rollback drill once per 12 months without charge.

Can I get legal to review two items internally: (1) proposed language for "custody attestation" and (2) limited liability carveouts around witness events. Irene/Connor — could you weigh in on the redlines attached? I highlighted the sections I expect to be sensitive to procurement.

If these look reasonable to you, I'll loop back with Marta to agree a witness window and issue a DocuSign envelope for the annex + order form amendment.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-04T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy evidence & witness ask — MSA annex needs and timeline

Lauren — reviewed the draft annex. High-level suggestions below; I also attached in-line language in the redline doc.

1) Custody attestation clause (suggested text):
"Upon completion of an agreed-upon witness event, Redwood will deliver a signed Custody Attestation confirming the snapshot identifier, UTC timestamp, and a list of artifacts observed. The Attestation is limited to descriptive facts and does not constitute a representation regarding the absence of vulnerabilities or completeness of customer data."

2) Snapshot transfer / onsite access: require customer-signed limited-access addendum and a minimum 10-business-day notice for logistics. Limit liability for transferred snapshots to direct damages capped at the fees paid in the preceding 12 months.

3) Witness procedure: keep remote witness as default; if customer requires onsite witness, add exhibit with travel / logistics & security badgeing requirements.

4) Rollback drill: make it an operational test limited to staging environment with a written acceptance form. If rollback results in production impact due to customer-supplied scripts, carveout liability.

I'll mark the redline with exact clause text and send back by EOD. Connor — please flag any operational constraints (snapshot creation cadence, retention costs).

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearpath.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-04T18:40:00Z
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy evidence & witness ask — MSA annex needs and timeline

Marta — quick update and proposed next steps based on legal feedback.

Summary of agreed points (draft annex attached):
- Redwood will perform a remote operator witness (2 hour session with runbook) during onboarding; postal/onsite witness can be added as an exhibit with cost recovery.
- Custody Attestation: Redwood will produce a signed attestation with snapshot id and UTC timestamp. Text is limited to factual statements only (Irene included suggested language).
- Retention: default 90 days; ClearPath may opt to extend to 12 months via Order Form exhibit (we've included pricing rows in the attached timeline).
- Rollback drill: operational-only test in a non-production environment; acceptance requires customer-signed test report.

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm whether ClearPath can commit to the audit window Sep 20–25 for the onboarding witness. If yes, we'll reserve internal engineering resources and provision the snapshot schedule.
2) Review the attached redline (CPH-MSA-Annex-draft-redline.docx) and let us know any specific language edits.
3) Once confirmed, we'll send a DocuSign envelope (linked) with the Annex + Order Form amendment for signature.
